label: Senior Full-Stack Developer
summary: Senior Full-Stack Developer with 8+ years of experience building and supporting production web applications across healthcare and e-commerce. Delivers end-to-end solutions with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS, with hands-on experience in API design, authentication, data modeling, cloud deployment, and CI/CD. Known for modernizing legacy workflows and translating complex product requirements into maintainable, user-focused software.

bullets.text: Led platform development and DevOps for healthcare integration environments, deploying containerized services and partner EHR sandboxes with Docker and Fly.io.
Implemented a Medplum-based SMART on FHIR workflow for consent-aware EHR-to-EHR interoperability using OAuth2, CDS, and privacy services.
Built and maintained integration components spanning Node.js, Drizzle ORM, Java, Spring Boot, Apache Camel, Debezium, OpenMRS, and FHIR services.
Developed a Next.js dashboard for managing FHIR consent forms and questionnaire responses using FHIR R5, authentication, and Vercel KV.
Authored reusable FHIR profiles and value sets with FSH and SUSHI for a scalable clinical research consent framework.
Built Shopify embedded applications with React, Polaris, App Bridge, GraphQL, and a Phoenix backend for wishlist and bundle-pricing workflows.
Introduced a monorepo architecture and Docker-based development workflow to improve module reuse and deployment consistency.
Built a production consent management platform with React, Redux, Node.js, GraphQL, AWS AppSync, Cognito, Lambda, and DynamoDB.
Replaced Webpack with Vite, cutting GitHub Actions build time from 8 minutes to 2 minutes and improving local feedback cycles.
Developed a custom Shopify storefront and administration tools with Web Components, GraphQL, Next.js, Koa, and Shopify APIs.
Created bulk tag, metafield, and CSV workflows that reduced catalog maintenance time by 40%.
Built and documented reusable JavaScript and Liquid solutions for Shopify integrations, reducing internal support resolution time by 30%.
